capabilities: Search Unicode characters by name, codepoint, or keywords
Mark favourite characters and assign quick-insert hotkeys
Filter searches with configurable character pools of planes, blocks, and categories
Access recently and frequently used characters from history
extras: Warns that a default set of character-pool filters is active, so some characters may be excluded from search results; mentions mobile support.
problem: Typing Unicode characters that aren't on the keyboard requires looking up codepoints elsewhere and copying them by hand.
summary: Command-palette style search modal that indexes the Unicode Character Database and inserts any character or codepoint into the editor.
